channel.title: US Top News and Analysis
channel.description: CNBC is the world leader in business news and real-time financial market coverage. Find fast, actionable information.

item.title: Israel-Hezbollah clashes deepen threat to fragile truce as Lebanon's president calls for U.S. support
item.description: Lebanese President Joseph Aoun called on the U.S. to help stop Israeli attacks after Sunday strikes killed at least seven people.

item.title: Asia-Pacific markets rise as investors assess renewed Middle East hostilities
item.description: Asia-Pacific markets open broadly higher on Monday, after they closed mostly in the green from the last trading session on Friday.

item.title: Treasury yields face 4.8% test as fiscal risks threaten to spill into other assets
item.description: Treasury yields face a test at 4.8%, with a sustained move above that potentially creating "meaningful problems" for other asset classes, said Miller Tabak.

item.title: Treasurys are losing foreign appeal in a historic capital flow reversal — and here's one trade investors favor instead
item.description: U.S. bonds are losing their appeal among overseas investors in what strategists say is a historic capital reversal.

item.title: Volcano eruption disrupts hundreds of flights at Southeast Asia's second-busiest airport
item.description: Mount Anak Krakatau’s eruption disrupted hundreds of flights across Indonesia, with flight cancellations extending into Monday.

item.title: AI data centers are transforming rural land markets — and fueling a backlash
item.description: The data center buildout is driving up the price of rural land as some farmers and property owners buy in and others push back against development.

item.title: Goldman boosts Asia ex-Japan index target for one big reason
item.description: Goldman raises its forecast for MSCI AC Asia Pacific ex-Japan Index on expectations for higher earnings forecasts led by Taiwan and Korea.

item.title: At least 5 dead after Amazon cargo plane barreled off runway at Miami airport
item.description: The aircraft overran the runway around 2 p.m. ET after arriving from San Juan, Puerto Rico.

item.title: Data centers in space: Four big obstacles and Elon Musk's ambitious timeline
Goldman Sachs says buy the dip in these five stocks before it's too late
item.description: The Wall Street investment bank said this week investors should take advantage of recent declines in several stocks.

item.title: With HSAs, employers are turning to the 401(k) playbook
item.description: More employers are automatically enrolling workers into health savings accounts and paying contributions like a "match."

item.title: Trump admin targets tax-exempt status at private colleges — threatening a key tax break for donations
item.description: The Treasury has proposed regulations that would strip thousands of private schools of their tax-exempt status and threaten a valuable tax break for donations.

item.title: Far-right AfD wins historic victory in German state election
item.description: The AfD is now Germany's most popular party nationally, polling at 28% according to a recent INSA poll, comfortably ahead of the conservatives at 20%.

item.title: Assailant lunged at Democratic candidate for Ohio governor Amy Acton at fair, campaign says
item.description: The Ohio gubernatorial race is one of the most high-profile races this year as the campaigns enter the final weeks of campaigning before the November election.

item.title: SEC sues ISS as Trump administration ramps up scrutiny of proxy advisers
item.description: The SEC sued Institutional Shareholder Services to enforce a subpoena as the Trump administration increases scrutiny of influential proxy advisers.

item.title: Trump turns up the heat on Warsh as Fed rate hike looms
item.description: Ten days ahead of the next Federal Reserve meeting, the Trump administration looks to be in a full-court press to halt a rate hike in its tracks.

item.title: Sugar is outperforming the stock market this year. Here's what's driving it, and where it can go from here
item.description: The sweetener's prices surged last week, reflecting a sharp deterioration in the global supply outlook.

item.title: U.S. Energy Secretary Wright says Iran nuclear deal may never happen
item.description: Iran warned of faster, heavier retaliation against U.S. attacks while acknowledging the war’s mounting toll on its economy.

item.title: U.S. envoys make first Kyiv visit amid Ukraine war peace push
NFL Commissioner Roger Goodell agrees on a 4-year contract extension
item.description: New England Patriots owner Robert Kraft said in a memo: "We believe we are very fortunate to have Roger at the helm for the next four years."

item.title: Meet the CISO: A new front line star in the AI cybersecurity war
item.description: The OpenAI-Hugging Face agent hack sent shockwaves through the business world and helped put the chief information security officer into the spotlight.

item.title: OPEC+ keeps oil output policy unchanged for October
item.description: The Iran war continues to ​disrupt oil exports through the Strait of Hormuz, limiting OPEC+'s influence over prices and market ​share.

item.title: ‘Model fatigue’ sets in as AI labs race to roll out new versions at frenetic pace
item.description: Anthropic, OpenAI, Meta and Google all released model updates this week, while Nvidia said it's acquiring open-source AI platform Hugging Face.

item.title: This enhanced geothermal project aims to unlock gigawatts of power to fuel the data center boom
item.description: Power demand in the U.S. is rising. Fervo Energy bets that its project in Utah will prove that enhanced geothermal can be part of the power mix going forward.

item.title: Trump’s state capitalism comes to the oil industry with his unprecedented Venezuela deal
item.description: The deal comes eight months after Washington ousted former President Nicolás Maduro in a military raid.

item.title: LeBron James teases partnership with Polymarket
item.description: LeBron James on Saturday teased an upcoming partnership with the prediction markets platform Polymarket in a social media post.

item.title: 'Everyone has an AI secret': This artist has spent a year collecting and sharing hundreds of anonymous AI confessions
item.description: Through her project "What We Tell AI," Olivia Tai has collected over 350 handwritten secrets about how people use AI to navigate dating, work and life.

item.title: Trump administration makes another appeal to the Supreme Court to allow mail-in ballot restrictions
item.description: The filing came after a U.S. District Court judge extended an order against the Postal Service enforcing an executive order for the November elections.

item.title: South Korea's AI rally is reshaping romance, reality shows and academic preferences
item.description: South Korea rally is changing what Koreans watch, how Koreans date, and what Koreans study.

item.title: Women accounted for almost all of job gains in August. Here's why
item.description: Women accounted for virtually all of August's payroll gains, the latest sign of their growing power in the labor market.
